title: Choose difficulty
hours: Licence exams and logged real hours only count in Real mode.

assisted.label: Simple
assisted.blurb: Third-person view and station keeping, no video delay. The crew runs the pre-dive checks for you. Best for learning the feel.

standard.label: Standard
standard.blurb: Onboard camera with video delay; depth hold on, station keeping off. Full pre-dive checks. Between Simple and Real.

real.label: Real
real.blurb: Matches the real vehicle: onboard, delayed video, no assists beyond the hardware. Full pre-dive checks. The hardcore default.
